info.name: Fetch the Latest Run for a Camera or Program

params.name: camera_id
params.description: The camera_id should be valid for the given accessToken.

params.name: program_id
params.description: The configured program's ID on the camera.

params.name: startedAtMs
params.description: EndMs is an optional param. It will default to the current time.

params.name: include
params.description: Include is a filter parameter. Accepts 'pass', 'reject' or 'no_read'.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit is an integer value from 1 to 1,000.
